name: Cedar Course Co. - Refund Request (tool, demo, not live)

parameters.content:
## Refund request tool
The agent only asks. This workflow decides.

- Not found, not the sender's order, already refunded, not paid, older than 14 days: nothing is logged.
- Over 150 USD: nothing is logged; the agent hands the chat to a person.
- Otherwise one row goes to the "Refunds" sheet with status "pending approval". A person approves it by hand.

This workflow never moves money.
